answer: Honeypot canaries: the protocol seeds answers that look legitimate but are deliberately wrong, each stamped with a hidden cipher only the ledger can verify. A Sybil ring can forge aligned grades to skim the grader pool, yet approving a single canary flags the whole colluding cluster and suspends its seats 48 epochs. Every forged verdict is thus a blind bet against an invisible trap; to profit an attacker must out-judge honest graders on every seat forever, so piling fake jurors is as useless as hoarding yellowed ivory.
